question: Do causally lagged Binance USD-M futures flow or positioning variables add stable predictive value beyond the executable Polymarket price?

source.checksum_contract: Every archive was verified against its adjacent Binance .CHECKSUM file.

shared_method.model: ridge-regularized logistic meta-label with logit(executable market price) as offset
shared_method.features: fixed before scoring; no feature subset or threshold search
shared_method.feed_forward: begin after eight prior folds; select ridge on the final two strictly prior folds; refit on all prior folds; score the next fold once
shared_method.condition_weighting: each resolved condition has total weight one
pass_gates: positive Brier and log-loss improvement overall
positive Brier and log-loss improvement in both chronological halves
positive lower bounds for both 95% condition-bootstrap intervals
mean probability correction on exact known losses is non-positive

screens.name: prior_closed_minute_taker_flow
screens.causal_cutoff: use only fully closed one-minute futures klines before the decision minute
screens.reason: The feature worsened both proper scores in both halves and increased probability more on known losses than winners.

screens.name: lagged_position_crowding
features: direction-aligned log top-trader position long-short ratio
screens.causal_cutoff: latest metrics snapshot must be at least one full five-minute bucket old
screens.reason: Aggregate improvement is concentrated in the first half; the second half is negative, both bootstrap intervals cross zero, and the known-loss correction remains positive.

frozen_forward_model.interpretation: Final validation selects strong shrinkage; the positioning coefficients are nearly zero and do not justify strategy integration.

freshness_audit.note: No sweep, parquet scan, or CPU-intensive task was run on the VPS.

verdict.grade: A- research system; strategy remains below A+
verdict.reason: Taker flow is decisively negative and positioning is chronologically unstable. Neither passes the predeclared causal screen, so exact profitability replay is not authorized.
verdict.next_step: Score the frozen, strongly regularized positioning diagnostic only on a genuinely new fully resolved block; require fresh proper-score and known-loss guards before reconsidering exact strategy replay.
